description: The day's stand-in audit. A class nobody checks never moves its ladder, so once a day the harness picks up to 3 decisions the stand-in made alone (AUDIT_PICKED, sent to the harness by the session that read the decision log; the picks are logPrecedent effect ids, which the decision log resolves from the store's own outbox and ignores when they name no stand-in decision). The audit asks the host to post one card (postAuditCard): option 0 confirms every pick, option i reverses pick i. The host's ack of that effect names the card's message id (CARD_POSTED), and the answer is AUDIT_ANSWERED from the person, by a tap on that card, exactly as a decision's PERSON_DECIDED. The decision log and the ladder read the answer from the event log (one person's decision per pick, dated when the person answered); no file in the store is read for a rung.

awaitingPerson.description: The audit card is in front of the person. Its message id arrives with the ack of postAuditCard (CARD_POSTED), and only a tap on it answers.

CARD_POSTED.description: Refused unless a session sends it: the host session that posted the card acks the postAuditCard effect with the card's message id (harness ack <effect> --card <cmsg id>).
Refused unless it names one message id (cmsg_...) and this audit has no card yet.

AUDIT_ANSWERED.description: Refused unless the actor is a person and the source a tap.
Refused unless the tap's ref is this audit's card, the message id CARD_POSTED recorded on the ack of its postAuditCard effect. A tap on no card, an unposted card or another card changes nothing.
Refused unless the option is one of the card's: 0 (all right) or i, 1 to the number of picks (reverse pick i).

answered.description: The person answered. The event log holds the answer; the decision log turns it into one person's decision per pick.
